predict.question: Your team's dashboard counts ten usable items and ten unusable ones as output. What percentage of the counted items is usable?

exploreHint: Run both cases; compare the changed input.
bookIdea: Measure What Matters pairs an objective with measurable results intended to express progress toward it.
modelBoundary: A shows {A}%; B shows {B}%. The count doubles from ten to twenty, but usable outputs remain ten and their fraction halves. Usability is a stipulated binary score; no organizational incentive effect is inferred.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? Real-world applicability and the connection to the book remain unverified.
